subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan keys, should OpenClaw route users only to `volcengine-plan` coding models, allow the same key to unlock general `volcengine` DeepSeek rows, or show a targeted diagnostic when the key is used on a general endpoint?
rationale: Current source and docs expose both provider routes from one auth choice, but the reported failure depends on vendor entitlement behavior that should be decided and live-verified before changing plugin routing or diagnostics.

options.title: Keep open for live route decision
options.body: A maintainer or credentialed tester verifies Lite-key behavior on the general and coding endpoints, then chooses the plugin-owned route/diagnostic contract.

options.title: Document current split only
options.body: Treat Lite keys as valid only for coding endpoints and update docs/diagnostics without changing catalog routing.

options.title: Broaden route support
options.body: Add or remap Lite-compatible DeepSeek/Coding Plan rows if live proof shows the vendor supports that model through the coding endpoint.

recommendation.title: Keep open for live route decision
recommendation.body: A maintainer or credentialed tester verifies Lite-key behavior on the general and coding endpoints, then chooses the plugin-owned route/diagnostic contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current provider-auth alias and Volcengine plugin boundary history points to steipete as the best available routing owner for this product/API decision.
